name: Elementor Sticky Header & Footer Builder
author: guruprasad123

sections.description:
Elementor Sticky Header & Footer Builder is a lightweight WordPress plugin that lets you create custom headers and footers in Elementor with advanced sticky header functionality.

If you want a professional sticky navigation bar, fixed header, or custom Elementor header that stays visible while scrolling, this plugin gives you full control without coding.

Design beautiful headers and footers using Elementor’s drag-and-drop builder and apply sticky behavior across your entire website or selected pages.

Perfect for bloggers, business websites, agencies, WooCommerce stores, and freelancers who want a clean modern sticky header experience.

Why use this plugin?

Most themes limit header customization. This plugin unlocks full Elementor header and footer design freedom while adding smooth sticky scrolling behavior.

✔ Create custom Elementor headers
✔ Create custom Elementor footers
✔ Add sticky header on scroll
✔ Apply to entire site or specific pages
✔ Lightweight and fast
✔ No coding required
✔ Works with all modern WordPress themes

Use cases

  • Sticky navigation menu
  • Fixed header for landing pages
  • Custom Elementor header builder
  • WooCommerce sticky shop header
  • Agency website navigation
  • Blog header that stays visible on scroll

Elementor Integration

This plugin works seamlessly with Elementor and extends its power by allowing global header and footer templates with sticky positioning.

Design once and reuse anywhere.

Pro Version

Upgrade to Pro for advanced features:

✔ Sticky header animations
✔ Scroll hide/show effects
✔ Mobile sticky controls
✔ Header templates
✔ Advanced visibility rules
✔ Priority support

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate via WordPress admin
  3. Go to Settings → Permalinks and click Save
  4. Enable Header/Footer post types in Elementor settings
  5. Start designing with Elementor
sections.faq:
Can I use this plugin without Elementor?

No. Elementor is required.

Can I control which pages show sticky header?

Yes. You can apply it globally or on specific pages.

Will it work with my theme?

Yes. It works with most modern WordPress themes.
